ordered_diagnoses: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Caruncle

facts.raw_span: a 4-week history of a rapidly growing left caruncular lesion
an amelanotic, pedunculated mass with an ulcerated surface, arising from the caruncle
no evidence of PAM (primary acquired melanosis)
The specimen measured 8 × 6 × 5 mm and had a 4-mm ulceration with necrotic tissue on its surface
Revealed a solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface, composed of large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
Showed positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
The Ki-67 proliferation marker showed a significant number of cycling cells
Sentinel lymph node biopsy findings were negative
Conjunctival and orbital biopsies revealed no tumor
Ulcerated, pedunculated, caruncular tumor
Mitotically active tumor containing anaplastic epithelioid cells
Melanoma cells showing immunoreactivity for Melan-A
